limitation: NASA POWER climate observations are not equivalent to farm-level sensor measurements
mitigation: Allow farm-specific/local observations and future sensor integration

limitation: PlantVillage images are controlled benchmark data and do not establish field performance
mitigation: Validate on independent field datasets and locally collected images

limitation: Phase 13 image observations are not temporally linked to Phase 14 climate observations
mitigation: Do not make causal climate-to-disease claims; collect linked longitudinal field data

limitation: Integrated-risk weights are methodological choices rather than empirically learned causal weights
mitigation: Future calibration against agronomic outcomes and expert elicitation

limitation: Resource Pressure and Exposure are normalized indicators rather than measured savings
mitigation: Integrate actual irrigation, yield, cost and resource-use records

limitation: Recommendations are decision-support rules and require local agronomic validation
mitigation: Add crop-, region-, soil- and growth-stage-specific validation

limitation: Global applicability has not been experimentally established
mitigation: Evaluate across climates, cultivars, soils and farming systems

limitation: Model confidence is not equivalent to diagnostic certainty
mitigation: Calibrate probabilities and introduce abstention/uncertainty mechanisms
